Promotion & partnership (2/4)

Moroccans of the World
Investment Week for MDM: August 11-15, 2025

A 360° initiative comprising 3 major actions:
• Deployment of a large-scale communication campaign, including urban billboards on key routes in the region’s main cities, and the setup of welcome desks at major points of entry for Moroccans Living Abroad (MRE), particularly airports.
• Organization of a regional information caravan, through seminars and meetings dedicated to MRE.
• Establishment of local welcome and guidance units, at the Tangier headquarters as well as at the branches in Tétouan and Al Hoceima.

Caravan Report:
• Approximately 58,000 views on social media
• 120 media mentions (press, TV, radio, and digital)
• 150 participants in seminars and thematic meetings
• 72 MRE welcomed at the CRI headquarters and branches
• 65 MRE assisted at airports
• 137 MRE assisted in total
• 8 MRE files submitted and supported

A successful campaign according to MDM feedback

“The CRI supported me, from the moment I arrived in Morocco, in setting up my business as well as in all the administrative procedures related to my project. I invite my fellow citizens abroad to come and invest in Morocco: the CRI team is available, attentive, multilingual, and truly facilitates every step of the way…”

Mohamed Bourkha, Société Nekour Beach Club, Hotel - Al Hoceima

“Vegetaland warmly thanks the entire CRI team for their unwavering support during our setup in Tétouan and the creation of our cooperative. The Tétouan branch team demonstrates exemplary professionalism and constant hands-on support…”

Touria Bouzidi, Présidente de la Coopérative Vegetaland - Tétouan

“As the founder of a guesthouse project in Tétouan, I am leaving this meeting with a stronger vision, useful contacts, and great motivation to make this project a reality in my home region…”

Rajae El Bakkali, Maison d’hôte, Ancienne Médina - Tétouan

www.investangier.com

Promotion & Partnerships (4/4)

Strategic Partnerships

CRI-IFC Partnership: Agreement with the International Finance Corporation (World Bank Group)

New CRI-IFC Partnership Agreement

The objective of the IFC – CRI TTA partnership is to increase private climate-friendly investments in the TTA region by improving the business climate for green investments and establishing a targeted strategy to attract green investments.
The project is 100% financed by the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs (SECO).

Component 1:
Improve the enabling environment for green investments

Component 2:
Promotion of green investments

Implementation phase: July 2024 – December 2027, with a budget of 1 Million USD over a 3-year period
